skill.summary: Audio generation skill. Automatically selects the best dlazy CLI audio/TTS model based on the prompt. 音频生成技能。根据提示词自动选择最佳的 dlazy CLI 音频/TTS 模型。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added instructions for login-based authentication using dlazy's device-code flow (`dlazy login`), making setup easier—no manual copy-paste required.
- Expanded Authentication section to clarify recommended and alternative authentication methods.
- Added section on piping between commands, documenting JSON pipe references and usage examples for chaining dlazy commands on the command line.
- Noted the correct music model name (`suno-music` instead of `suno.music`) under Available Audio Models.
- No code or endpoint changes; documentation improvements only.
